name: Executive order of November 19, 1892 restoring the Utah part of the 1884 Navajo addition to the public domain
promises: Royce records that this order modified the executive order of May 17, 1884, so that the lands it described west of 110 degrees west longitude and within Utah were restored to the public domain (Royce, p. 944).

sources.title: Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule pp. 944-945

openQuestions: This is an executive order reducing an executive-order reservation; under the project rule that is not a breach by itself, and no court, Commission, Act of Congress or government finding about this land and order was found (ICC full-text search for the order and the Paiute Strip returned nothing on point).
Later orders and Acts returning or adding Utah land to the Navajo Reservation were not researched.
The Navajo Nation's own account was not located.
